recent_articles.title: Lodhi Crematorium wall collapse: As a labourer dies, a family loses its home | Delhi News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A boundary wall and storage room collapsed at the Lodhi Crematorium in Delhi during construction work, killing one laborer and injuring two others. **PWD** workers were using a JCB and Hydra machine for excavation and pipe-laying when the incident occurred at 1:08 am.  The deceased laborer was identified as Rahul Kharwan, while injured laborers Rajesh (48) and Umar (20) are receiving treatment. The police, fire department, and ambulance personnel conducted a joint rescue operation before securing the site.

recent_articles.title: Can Supriya Life Sciences unlock its next leg of growth beyond APIs? | Smart Stocks News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Supriya Life Sciences**, an API manufacturer, is transitioning from a traditional API business to a broader pharmaceutical player. The company focuses on products where Chinese manufacturers dominate supply, positioning itself as an alternative supplier for regulated markets.  This strategy includes expanding into formulations, contrast media APIs, and contract manufacturing services. While the Ambernath facility represents a significant expansion, Supriya's growth is driven by multiple initiatives rather than a single project. The company faces execution risks related to commercialization timelines, customer qualification, and competition from Chinese manufacturers. Investors are evaluating Supriya based on its existing API business but will need to assess the success of these new initiatives in the coming years.

recent_articles.title: Farah Khan stunned by Terence Lewis' surreal Salvador Dalí bathroom, throne-like commode
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Terence Lewis**, a celebrity choreographer and reality show judge, recently gave **Farah Khan**, a filmmaker-choreographer, a tour of his opulent Mumbai house. The home features luxurious yet elegant decor elements like metallic accents on the entrance door, plush seating in white and beige tones, and a black piano.  **Ishitta Arun**, an artisan from Jaipur, sourced an antique-style door with detailed carvings for the living space. **Farah Khan** joked that the bathroom resembled a set from a Sanjay Leela Bhansali film, inspired by the surreal, molten-style basin designed by **Terence Lewis** in homage to **Salvador Dalí**.  The tour also included a cozy study and a kitchen with a striking chandelier made of tea kettles.

recent_articles.title: Kharge files nomination papers for Rajya Sabha polls from Karnataka - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, president of the **All India Congress Committee**, filed his nomination papers for the Rajya Sabha election from Karnataka, accompanied by **Rahul Gandhi**. The other two candidates are **Mansoor Ali Khan** and **Pawan Khera**.  The elections will be held on June 18th with the Congress party expected to secure three seats. Discussions regarding portfolio allocation among ministers were reportedly underway during a car ride.

recent_articles.title: Great Nicobar project meant to benefit Adani, it’s not about defence: Rahul Gandhi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha, criticized the **BJP**’s claim that the Great Nicobar Island project is strategic, alleging it's a ploy to benefit industrialist **Gautam Adani**.  Gandhi launched an online petition urging citizens to join his campaign titled “we choose green over greed,” highlighting concerns about ecological destruction and displacement of local communities. He argued that expanding the naval air station INS Baaz would be a more appropriate strategic move, while accusing the government of prioritizing commercial interests over environmental protection. **Mallikarjun Kharge**, Congress president, echoed these sentiments, criticizing the government's environmental record and deforestation rates.  Gandhi called for sustainable development in Great Nicobar, contrasting it with the proposed project that he believes would harm the island’s environment and indigenous communities.

recent_articles.title: Only 8 MLAs, 6 MPs At Mamata Banerjee's Home For Key Meet. Party Clarifies
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Only eight **Trinamool Congress** MLAs attended a National Working Committee meeting at former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee's Kalighat house in Kolkata, following a rebellion within the party.  The party clarified that not all MPs and MLAs were invited, with only four Lok Sabha MPs and two Rajya Sabha MPs present. **Abhishek Banerjee**, Mamata Banerjee's nephew, was among those who attended. Rebel MLA **Ritabrata Banerjee** stated that more MLAs will join the rebellion, increasing the number of supporters beyond 2/3rd of the party.

recent_articles.title: India Reports GDP Growth Of 7.8% In Q4 On Services Sector Output Boost
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India's** real GDP grew 7.8% year-on-year in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, exceeding market expectations and contributing to full-year growth of 7.7%. The secondary and tertiary sectors drove this growth, with the secondary sector expanding 8.8% and the tertiary sector growing 9.3%.  **The BJP** praised these figures, calling them a testament to India's economic strength while **Rahul Gandhi**, a Congress leader, warned of an "economic tsunami."

recent_articles.title: Congress Betrayed By Supporting TVK, Will Never Forget: Udhayanidhi Stalin
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Udhayanidhi Stalin**, leader of the **DMK**, accused the **Congress** of betraying the party by supporting Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) after the Tamil Nadu Assembly elections. He stated that elected Congress MLAs have not maintained contact with DMK leadership and criticized the Congress for failing to inform the DMK on key matters despite other alliance partners providing updates. This accusation has intensified tensions between the **DMK** and **Congress**, leading the **DMK** to skip the INDIA bloc meeting scheduled for June 8th in New Delhi.

recent_articles.title: Rahul Gandhi slams ‘broken system’ for NEET aspirant’s death - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Lok Sabha's** Opposition, criticized the **Narendra Modi government** following the death of Akanksha Chaturvedi, a NEET aspirant from Madhya Pradesh.  The 18-year-old reportedly died by suicide after allegedly being overwhelmed by depression due to the cancellation of the May 3 exam and allegations of a paper leak.  Gandhi accused the **Prime Minister** of creating a "corrupt and broken" education system and called for concrete action beyond committees and inquiries. The **National Testing Agency**, which conducted the NEET (UG) 2026 examination, is investigating the matter.

recent_articles.title: What is this stupid game?: Modi on IND players' reactions to inaugural T20 WC
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lalit Modi**, former **IPL** chairperson, recalled his efforts to convince Indian cricketers in 2007 to participate in the inaugural T20 World Cup.  He stated that players initially dismissed the format as a "stupid game" due to fatigue and family commitments. Despite this skepticism, India went on to win the tournament, which led to the birth of the IPL a year later. **Modi** questioned whether the public, players, administrators, and BCCI would accept a second-string team for future World Cups, arguing that such a move would face widespread disapproval.

recent_articles.title: Congress Picks Ex-MP, BJP 2 Top Leaders For Rajya Sabha From Madhya Pradesh
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** nominated former Mandsaur MP Meenakshi Natarajan for the Rajya Sabha seat vacated by Digvijaya Singh. The **BJP** has fielded Tarun Chugh and Rajneesh Agarwal, with the potential for a third candidate to influence the closely contested election in Madhya Pradesh.  While the BJP is expected to win two seats comfortably, the Congress appears poised to retain one.

recent_articles.title: Rahul ‘selling panic’, promoting baseless conspiracy theories: BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** accused **Rahul Gandhi** of promoting fear and baseless conspiracy theories about the Indian economy and institutions.  **Amit Malviya**, BJP IT Cell head, countered that Mr. Gandhi's claims about an "economic tsunami" and a collapsing system were unfounded. He highlighted India's resilience in the face of global challenges, citing strong reserves, low inflation, and robust economic indicators.

recent_articles.title: Rahul ‘selling panic’, promoting baseless conspiracy theories: BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** accused **Rahul Gandhi** of promoting fear and baseless conspiracy theories about India's institutions and economy.  **Amit Malviya**, the BJP's IT Cell head, countered that Mr. Gandhi's claims were unfounded and that the Indian economy was resilient despite global challenges. He cited strong reserves, low inflation, robust infrastructure spending, and record FDI inflows as evidence of India's economic strength.

recent_articles.title: Bhupinder Hooda's Remark Fuels Buzz Of Amarinder Singh's Congress Crossover
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Captain Amarinder Singh** is reportedly in contact with **Congress** leaders ahead of the Punjab elections next year, according to former Haryana chief minister **Bhupinder Hooda**.  **Hooda** described **Amarinder** as a senior Congress leader and long-time associate. **Amarinder**, who joined the BJP in 2021 after leaving the Congress, has expressed discomfort with the party's functioning and leadership style, citing a lack of personal outreach from leaders compared to the Congress.  While some senior Punjab Congress leaders have indicated that **Amarinder** would be welcomed back if he chooses to return, the BJP has dismissed the speculation as mere communication without political negotiations.

recent_articles.title: "Ideology With Which Party Was Formed Does Not Exist": Expelled Trinamool MLA Sandipan Saha
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress (TMC)** expelled MLA Sandipan Saha claims that 58 rebel MLAs elected **Ritabrata Banerjee** as Leader of Opposition after signing an attendance register which was later presented as a resolution, alleging forgery.  The rebellion has plunged the party into its gravest internal crisis since its inception, with the rebels securing recognition from the Assembly Speaker and forming their own leadership structure. Saha claims that he and other dissidents were silenced within the party and forced to raise concerns through social media.

recent_articles.title: "Party Bigger Than Positions": Karnataka Congress Chief B.K. Hariprasad Amid Cabinet Buzz
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **B.K. Hariprasad**, newly appointed **KPCC** president, emphasized the importance of prioritizing party strength and democratic values over power in leading the Karnataka Congress. He acknowledged concerns about women's representation in the cabinet and assured that it would be addressed during the next expansion.  He also stressed the need to strengthen the party's commitment to inclusivity and social balance, contrasting it with the BJP's single-leader ideology. **Hariprasad** expressed confidence in **D.K. Shivakumar**, the new chief minister, stating that he is capable of leading effectively despite challenges.

His expertise is particularly focused on West Bengal, where he has dedicated more than ten years to covering political developments. **Ravik Bhattacharya**, the Chief of Bureau of **The Indian Express**, Kolkata, boasts over 20 years of experience in journalism and specializes in politics, crime, major incidents, and investigative stories across various regions including West Bengal, Odisha, Assam, and the Andaman Nicobar Islands.  **Bhattacharya** has a long and distinguished career with notable awards, including the Ramnath Goenka Excellence in Journalism Award for Political Reporting in 2007.

recent_articles.title: Amid broken ties, Rahul, Kharge hail Karunanidhi on his birth anniversary - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge and **Rahul Gandhi** paid tributes to former Tamil Nadu Chief Minister **Muthuvel Karunanidhi**, fondly known as "Kalaignar," on his birthday.  Kharge praised **Karunanidhi's** lifelong commitment to social justice and democratic values, while Gandhi highlighted his dedication to the dignity of the Tamil people. The tributes are seen as an attempt to mend strained ties between the Congress and the DMK following the party's alliance with actor-turned politician Vijay's Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK).

recent_articles.title: Calcutta High Court to hear Abhishek’s plea seeking protection - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, general secretary of the **Trinamool Congress**, was granted permission by the Calcutta High Court to file a petition seeking protection against coercive action from the West Bengal CID. The court is expected to hear the matter later this week.  The legal team representing Mr. Banerjee argued that he had no connection to the case, while Enforcement Directorate officials served him with a notice for questioning in the primary teacher recruitment scam. Two Trinamool MLAs filed a complaint alleging forged signatures on a letter declaring **Sobhandeb Chattopadhyay** as the party's choice for Leader of Opposition (LoP), leading to an FIR and summons against Mr. Banerjee. The controversy has caused a split within the party, with at least 58 MLAs forming a new opposition group.

recent_articles.title: Congress Rahul Gandhi Priyanka Gandhi: With Eye On Upcoming Polls, Congress Plans Major Organisational Reshuffle
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the appointment of DK Shivakumar as Chief Minister of Karnataka, **BK Hariprasad** has been named the state Congress president.  The Congress is planning a major reshuffle across over six states, with a focus on poll-bound regions like Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Punjab, Goa, Manipur, Gujarat, and Himachal Pradesh. The party is considering replacing in-charges and state presidents to attract voters and balance caste dynamics. This reshuffle is expected to be the last major one under **Mallikarjun Kharge**'s leadership as Congress president.

recent_articles.title: ‘Unauthorised’ school in Chunabhatti ordered shut, students told to relocate | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parents** of students at **Orchids International School** in Mumbai's Chunabhatti were surprised to be asked to relocate their children to other branches after the school was declared unauthorized for operating without government permission. The **school** management has been informed about the unauthorized status since March 2026, and a fine of Rs 1,00,000 has been levied. Parents argue that they were misled by the school's assurances that the situation would be resolved before classes began.  The **school** claims to have issued new information to parents about the expected final approval for operations at the Chunabhatti location by July.

recent_articles.title: Exclusive With DK Shivakumar's Daughter, Brother After Big Karnataka Oath
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DK Shivakumar**, the newly sworn-in Chief Minister of Karnataka, faces high expectations from his family and the public. **Rahul Gandhi** urged focus on upcoming elections in 2028 and 2029, while Shivakumar's daughter Aisshwarya DKS Hegde emphasized a commitment to returning to power in future elections.  Shivakumar has already initiated plans for Bengaluru infrastructure improvements, building regularization, and free student bus rides.

recent_articles.title: Pseudo-police gang that kidnapped businessman and extorted ₹5.26 lakh busted in Cyberabad - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Cyberabad police** arrested five members of a pseudo-police gang who allegedly kidnapped a businessman, impersonated police officers, and extorted over ₹5 lakh from him. The suspects, identified as Nagaraju Raghu Varma, Yeswanth Singh alias Rahul, Sathyabhan Singh alias Thakur, Thangellapalli Nagendra Varma, and two others still at large, were apprehended following an investigation into the incident reported by a 42-year-old businessman in Kukatpally. The gang used fake police uniforms, forged identity cards, and other tactics to deceive their victims before withdrawing money from his bank accounts and assaulting him.  Police are continuing to investigate and identify additional victims.

recent_articles.title: D K Shivakumar sworn in as 24th state CM, ex-CM Siddaramaiah’s son gets cabinet berth | Bangalore News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D K Shivakumar**, the newly elected leader of the **Congress Legislature Party (CLP)** in Karnataka, was sworn in as the state's 24th chief minister alongside a 13-person cabinet. The ceremony, attended by Congress top brass, CMs of three states, and outgoing CM Siddaramaiah, took place on Wednesday at Lok Bhavan.  Shivakumar, who ascended to the position after leading the Congress to victory in the 2023 state elections, emphasized his commitment to youth leadership and a new era for Karnataka. The cabinet, largely composed of members from the previous Siddaramaiah administration, reflects the Congress's efforts to maintain its caste base while balancing power dynamics.

recent_articles.title: Mamata Banerjee, Abhishek Banerjee, Leader of Opposition, Ritabrata Banerjee, Sandipan Saha - "Real" Trinamool Backs Rebel For Key Post, Says 'Mamata Banerjee Our Leader'
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress** MLA Ritabrata Banerjee claims to have the support of 59 MLAs, aiming to challenge **Mamata Banerjee's** nominee for Leader of Opposition, **Sobhandeb Chattopadhyay**.  Banerjee alleges forged signatures on a letter supporting Chattopadhyay. The Assembly Secretariat has filed a police case into the matter, with the CID investigating. Chief Minister **Suvendu Adhikari** stated that three Trinamool MLAs confessed to not signing the document.

recent_articles.title: D.K. Shivakumar sworn-in as 25th Chief Minister of Karnataka - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, the newly elected **Chief Minister of Karnataka**, was sworn in on Wednesday, June 3, 2026, alongside **G. Parameshwara** as Deputy Chief Minister.  The swearing-in ceremony took place at Glass House in Lok Bhavan and saw the inclusion of 13 Cabinet ministers, with a focus on senior party members. The event was attended by prominent figures from across the political spectrum, including Rahul Gandhi and Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu. Shivakumar's administration will face challenges as it navigates the upcoming Rajya Sabha and Karnataka Legislative Council elections.

recent_articles.title: Open to dialogue with Govt, Opposition; CBSE transfers ‘eyewash’: Cockroach Janata Party holds first press conference - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Cockroach Janata Party (CJP)**, led by Abhijeet Dipke, announced its readiness for dialogue with the government and opposition over demands related to Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation following the NEET and CBSE fiasco. The party plans a protest on June 6th at Jantar Mantar, demanding accountability in the system.  **Saurav Das**, CJP spokesperson, criticized the government's recent transfers of **Rahul Singh** and **Himanshu Gupta**, calling them "eyewash."  The party also expressed concern about potential police action against founder **Dipke** and climate activist **Sonam Wangchuk**.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, the newly sworn-in Chief Minister of Karnataka, began his day with personal and political gestures, including calls to MLAs and a visit to former Chief Ministers **B.S. Yediyurappa** and **H.D. Deve Gowda**. He chose traditional attire for his oath ceremony and invited Congress leaders **Rahul Gandhi**, **Mallikarjun Kharge**, and **Sonia Gandhi** to the event, which was attended by high-ranking members of the **Congress** party from other states.  The ceremony also included a gathering of religious leaders representing various faiths.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka Chief Minister DK Shivakumar Takes Oath, G Parameshwara Is His Deputy
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DK Shivakumar**, a prominent figure in the **Congress**, took oath as the Chief Minister of Karnataka, ending a two-year political tussle. His cabinet of 13 ministers includes his predecessor's son, **Yathindra Siddaramaiah**.  G Parameshwara was appointed Deputy Chief Minister, balancing social factions within the party. The event saw participation from Congress leaders like **Rahul Gandhi**, **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**, and other state chief ministers. Shivakumar expressed gratitude to the **Gandhi family** for their support in his political journey.

recent_articles.title: Expelled Trinamool Rebel Ritabrata Banerjee Becomes Leader Of Opposition In Bengal
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Speaker Rathindra Bose** approved **Ritabrata Banerjee**, a rebel leader, as the Leader of the Opposition in West Bengal's assembly.  **Firhad Hakim**, a key aide to **Mamata Banerjee**, resigned as Kolkata Mayor amidst turmoil within the Trinamool Congress. The party dissolved all its committees and frontal organizations, claiming introspection is necessary. **Ritabrata Banerjee** asserted that he has the support of 59 of the party's 80 MLAs and claimed **Mamata Banerjee** is the leader of the faction.  The events appear to follow a similar pattern as Maharashtra's political upheaval involving the Shiv Sena and NCP, with the Trinamool Congress alleging BJP involvement in the split.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. recent_articles.title: Ahead of Shivakumar’s swearing-in as CM, Siddaramaiah appointed CWC member | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Siddaramaiah**, the former Karnataka Chief Minister, was appointed a member of the **Congress Working Committee (CWC)** on Tuesday by **Mallikarjun Kharge**.  The day-long deliberations with **Shivakumar** and **Siddaramaiah** focused on finalizing the new Cabinet. The oath-taking ceremony for **Shivakumar**, who will be sworn in as the 34th Chief Minister, is scheduled for Wednesday.  The event will be held at the state Lok Bhavan with a limited number of attendees.

recent_articles.title: Lokhande Prashant Sitaram Appointed CBSE Chairman, Varun Bhardwaj Named Secretary
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prashant Sitaram Lokhande** has been appointed Chairman of the **Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)**, replacing **Rahul Singh**, who is now in the Agriculture Ministry. **Varun Bhardwaj**, a 2008-batch Indian Information Service officer, was named Secretary of the education board amidst controversy over its new on-screen marking system. A one-member committee is reviewing the OSM system and will provide findings to the government soon. The CBSE has opened a re-evaluation website for students to address concerns about the evaluation process and technical glitches.

recent_articles.title: Rahul says CBSE transfers a cover-up, demands Pradhan’s sacking | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi** and **Mallikarjun Kharge** criticized the government's transfer of **CBSE Chairman Rahul Singh** and **Secretary Himanshu Gupta**, calling it a cover-up for the ongoing On-Screen Marking row.  They demanded the dismissal of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** and an independent judicial inquiry, arguing that the transfers were not accountability but a way to deflect attention from the minister's alleged corruption. **Jairam Ramesh** also expressed concern over the sudden departure of leadership and the formation of a one-member commission, highlighting the irregularities exposed by Gen Z students.

recent_articles.title: Shivakumar set to take oath as Karnataka CM in lowkey ceremony | Bangalore News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D K Shivakumar**, the newly elected 34th Chief Minister of **Karnataka**, will take his oath on Wednesday alongside a first batch of around 10 ministers. The ceremony, held at the state Lok Bhavan with limited fanfare, is expected to include several senior ministers from the Siddaramaiah cabinet and two young ministers, including **Priyank Kharge** and **Krishna Byre Gowda**.  The Congress leadership has opted for a low-key swearing-in, prioritizing balancing caste equations in the new cabinet. **Rahul Gandhi**, **Mallikarjun Kharge**, and **V D Satheesan** are expected to attend the ceremony.

recent_articles.title: Amid War Of Words With Revanth Reddy, Pawan Kalyan's Party's Big Move
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pawan Kalyan**, chief of the **Jana Sena Party**, announced his party's intention to contest the upcoming Telangana assembly elections.  Kalyan accused **Congress** leaders of separatist behavior and hypocrisy, criticizing their silence on the roles played by the Communist Party of India (Marxist) and AIMIM in the Telangana movement. He also questioned a Congress leader's admiration for Pakistan and urged **Rahul Gandhi** and **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra** to respond to his allegations.  Kalyan emphasized his long-standing support for Telangana culture and stated that Jana Sena is not opposed to the state's existence, but rather its formation process.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka CM swearing-in ceremony: Elaborate security in place at Lok Bhavan in Bengaluru - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bengaluru City Police** have implemented extensive security and traffic management arrangements for the swearing-in ceremony of the Chief Minister at **Lok Bhavan** on Wednesday.  The event will be restricted to invited guests only, with limited seating capacity and no roadshow. **City Police Commissioner Seemant Kumar Singh** has deployed additional police platoons and reserve force companies across the city, along with surveillance measures including CCTV cameras, LED screens, and drones. The **Bengaluru City Police** have also declared a temporary no-fly zone around the **KPCC office** and **Hotel Shangri-La**, prohibiting drone operations within a one-kilometer radius.

recent_articles.title: Stage set for D.K. Shivakumar to over as new CM of Karnataka - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, the eight-time legislator and Karnataka Pradesh Congress Committee president, will be sworn in as the 34th Chief Minister of Karnataka on Wednesday evening at Lok Bhavan.  The list of Cabinet ministers is expected to be released by the **Congress central leadership** on Wednesday, with speculation about new faces joining the existing cabinet. The event will be attended by prominent leaders like **Rahul Gandhi**, **Mallikarjun Kharge**, and other state chief ministers. Traffic restrictions are in place for the ceremony in Bengaluru.

recent_articles.title: List of Ministers to be sworn in with DKS to be finalised only June 3 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** central leadership is expected to announce the list of Cabinet ministers, including D.K. Shivakumar, on Wednesday morning.  The final list may include between 10 and 15 ministers, with negotiations ongoing regarding the Deputy Chief Minister's post and the creation of a coordination committee. **Siddaramaiah** and **Shivakumar** have been meeting with the central leadership to finalize their preferences for cabinet positions and the Karnataka Pradesh Congress Committee president.  The expansion of the Cabinet is expected to occur after the Rajya Sabha polls, pending consensus on regional and caste combinations.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool In Existential Crisis, Mamata Banerjee Calls It "Do Or Die" Fight
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, leader of the **Trinamool Congress**, declared it a "do or die battle" for her party's survival amidst internal revolt.  Approximately 50-60 out of 80 MLAs are reportedly rebelling against the leadership, leading to protests and allegations of forged signatures in the appointment of the Leader of Opposition. The party faces an existential crisis as it attempts to address public anger towards its long rule and quell internal dissent. **Mamata Banerjee** stated that she will not abandon her party workers despite the rebellion, and anti-BJP parties are meeting in Delhi to discuss a nationwide course of action.

recent_articles.title: CBSE Chairman, Secretary Transferred, Panel Formed To Probe Irregularities In On-Screen Marking System
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Singh** and **Himanshu Gupta**, the Chairman and Secretary of the **Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)**, have been transferred following controversy surrounding the On-screen Marking System (OSM). A one-member committee led by Ms. S Radha Chauhan will investigate irregularities including answer sheet mix-ups, evaluation errors, and misallocated grades. The CBSE's tender process for OSM has also come under scrutiny after concerns were raised about technical issues and payment failures.
